movies.title: Love, Death & Robots
movies.overview: Terrifying creatures, wicked surprises and dark comedy converge in this NSFW anthology of animated stories presented by Tim Miller and David Fincher.
movies.tagline: The threesome you've been waiting for.

seasons.name: Volume 1

episodes.title: SONNIE'S EDGE
episodes.overview: In the underground world of "beastie" fights, Sonnie is unbeatable -- as long as she keeps her edge.

episodes.title: THREE ROBOTS
episodes.overview: Long after the fall of humanity, three robots embark on a sightseeing tour of a post-apocalyptic city.

episodes.title: THE WITNESS
episodes.overview: After seeing a brutal murder, a woman flees from the killer through the streets of a surreal city.

episodes.title: SUITS
episodes.overview: A community of farmers use their homemade mechs to defend their families from an alien invasion.

episodes.title: SUCKER OF SOULS
episodes.overview: Unleashed by an archaeological dig, a bloodthirsty demon battles a team of mercenaries armed with... cats?

episodes.title: WHEN THE YOGURT TOOK OVER
episodes.overview: After scientists accidentally breed super-intelligent yogurt, it soon hungers for world domination.

episodes.title: BEYOND THE AQUILA RIFT
episodes.overview: Awakening after traveling light years off course, a ship's crew struggles to discover just how far they've come.

episodes.title: GOOD HUNTING
episodes.overview: The son of a spirit hunter forges a bond with a shape-shifting huli jing.

episodes.title: THE DUMP
episodes.overview: Ugly Dave calls the garbage dump home, and he's not about to let some city slicker take it away from him.

episodes.title: SHAPE-SHIFTERS
episodes.overview: Deep in Afghanistan, two Marines with supernatural powers face a threat from one of their own kind.

episodes.title: HELPING HAND
episodes.overview: Stranded in orbit, an astronaut must choose between life and limb before her oxygen runs out.

episodes.title: FISH NIGHT
episodes.overview: After their car breaks down in the desert, two salesmen take a dreamlike voyage to the dawn of time.

episodes.title: LUCKY 13
episodes.overview: After the drop-ship Lucky 13 lost two crews, no pilot would fly her... but rookies don't get a choice.

episodes.title: ZIMA BLUE
episodes.overview: The renowned artist Zima recounts his mysterious past and rise to fame before unveiling his final work.

episodes.title: BLINDSPOT
episodes.overview: A gang of cyborg thieves stage a high-speed heist of a heavily armored convoy.

episodes.title: ICE AGE
episodes.overview: A young couple moves into an apartment and finds a lost civilization inside their antique freezer.

episodes.title: ALTERNATE HISTORIES
episodes.overview: Want to see Hitler die in a variety of comically fantastic ways? Now you can. Welcome to Multiversity!

episodes.title: THE SECRET WAR
episodes.overview: Elite units of the Red Army fight an unholy evil deep in the ancient forests of Siberia.

episodes.title: Automated Customer Service
episodes.overview: If your home-cleaning unit is attempting to murder you, please press 3.

episodes.title: Ice
episodes.overview: Two brothers far from home join genetically "modded" locals in a deadly race.

episodes.title: Pop Squad
episodes.overview: A cop charged with fighting the scourge of overpopulation is haunted by the human toll of his work.

episodes.title: Snow in the Desert
episodes.overview: Every bounty hunter in the galaxy wants a piece of Snow.

episodes.title: The Tall Grass
episodes.overview: During a journey across the prairie, a man becomes transfixed by distant, ghostly lights.

episodes.title: All Through the House
episodes.overview: On Christmas Eve, two kids tiptoe downstairs to catch a glimpse of Santa. A twisted tale for adults only.

episodes.title: Life Hutch
episodes.overview: After crash-landing on a craggy planet, a pilot makes his way to shelter, only to face a threat within.

episodes.title: The Drowned Giant
episodes.overview: The body of a colossal young man washes ashore and becomes an object of fascination for the locals.

seasons.overview: From wild adventures on far-flung planets to unsettling encounters close to home: The Emmy-winning anthology returns with a crop of provocative tales.

seasons.name: Volume 3

episodes.title: Three Robots: Exit Strategies
episodes.overview: Three robots walk into the post-apocalypse… and take a whirlwind tour of humankind's last attempts to save itself.

episodes.title: Bad Travelling
episodes.overview: Release the Thanapod! A ship’s crew member sailing an alien ocean strikes a deal with a ravenous monster of the deep.

episodes.title: The Very Pulse of the Machine
episodes.overview: When an exploratory mission to a Jovian moon ends in disaster, the lone survivor must begin a perilous but mind-expanding journey.

episodes.title: Night of the Mini Dead
episodes.overview: A bit of unholy cemetery sex ends badly, kicking off a worldwide zombie plague. It’s the cutest apocalypse you’ll ever see.

episodes.title: Kill Team Kill
episodes.overview: US Special Forces are trained to neutralize any threat — even a cybernetic killing machine created by the CIA. Their secret weapon? A sense of humor.

episodes.title: Swarm
episodes.overview: Two human scientists study the secrets of an ancient alien entity — but soon learn the horrible price of survival in a hostile universe.

episodes.title: Mason's Rats
episodes.overview: Welcome to the Ratpocalypse! Farmer Mason knows he has a real pest problem when they start shooting back. Bloody hell!

episodes.title: In Vaulted Halls Entombed
episodes.overview: Modern warfare meets elder gods. A special forces squad on a hostage rescue mission finds themselves trapped in a prison containing an age-old evil.

episodes.title: Jibaro
episodes.overview: A deaf knight and a siren of myth become entwined in a deadly dance. A fatal attraction infused with blood, death and treasure.

seasons.overview: Uncanny worlds, strange creatures and twisted tales await in the third volume of the Emmy-winning animated anthology from Tim Miller and David Fincher.

episodes.title: Can't Stop
episodes.overview: Turn up your stereo and tune into a Red Hot Chili Peppers concert that's unlike any other — with a few strings attached.

episodes.title: Close Encounters of the Mini Kind
episodes.overview: They came in peace. But when their first encounter with Earthlings goes awry, these extra-tiny extraterrestrials are ready for vengeance.

episodes.title: Spider Rose
episodes.overview: At the edge of the galaxy, a grieving woman dreams of revenge. Can an adorable newcomer help her destroy her enemies — without destroying her humanity?

episodes.title: 400 Boys
episodes.overview: Are they gods? Are they giants? All this band of survivors knows is that they're deadly — and they'll have to set aside their own turf war to stop them.

episodes.title: The Other Large Thing
episodes.overview: This furry revolutionary has plans for world domination. All he needs is a henchman with opposable thumbs.

episodes.title: Golgotha
episodes.overview: A mysterious race of aquatic aliens has arrived on Earth. They don't want to be taken to our leaders.

episodes.title: The Screaming of the Tyrannosaur
episodes.overview: In an orbital arena, gladiators and dinosaurs compete in a deadly race — and face a terrifying new opponent.

episodes.title: How Zeke Got Religion
episodes.overview: On a perilous mission into hostile territory, the crew of a World War II bomber encounters an unholy enemy.

episodes.title: Smart Appliances, Stupid Owners
episodes.overview: From thermostats to toothbrushes to toilets, these ultra-modern appliances have something to say about their hapless owners.

episodes.title: For He Can Creep
episodes.overview: London, 1757. Satan battles a cat for the soul of a poet whose verse could give him dominion over the earth.

movies.title: The Passenger
movies.overview: Hassan, a Somali-American airport shuttle driver in Minneapolis, is struggling to make ends meet. When Lloyd, a stranded twenty-something at the airport, offers to pay Hassan to take him overland to Chicago, it seems worth the risk. But as the realization grows that his passenger is not what he seems, Hassan finds himself trapped in a terrifying ride that he can’t escape, knowing that saving himself might put countless others in danger.
movies.tagline: No way out. No way back.

movies.title: Mutiny
movies.overview: After witnessing his billionaire boss' murder and being framed for the crime, Cole Reed boards a cargo ship on a one-man crusade to avenge his boss' death only to discover an international conspiracy.
